query: Current fill percentage/storage of Lázaro Cárdenas (El Palmito) dam in Durango Mexico from Conagua SINA, latest daily readings for July 2026 and late June 2026
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's a summary of the key findings on the Lázaro Cárdenas ("El Palmito") dam:

**Most recent readings (2026):**
- **June 1, 2026:** 915.948 Mm³ (~31.0%) — Conagua report via POSTA
- **~June 8, 2026:** ~21% — Milenio (hydrometric report)
- **Mid-July (~July 16), 2026:** 598 Mm³ (~19% of NAMO) — Vanguardia

**Trajectory:** The reservoir has been **declining** through June into July 2026, from ~31% at the start of June down to ~19% by mid-July, as extractions (~109 m³/s to Las Tórtolas / the 750 Mm³ 2026 agricultural transfer) outpace modest early-rainy-season inflows. Local media frame this as a worsening water crisis threatening the 2027 cycle.

**Key caveat:** The live Conagua SINA "Monitoreo de Presas" portal is behind a challenge-validation gate and couldn't be scraped directly, so all figures come from Mexican news outlets citing Conagua's official daily/weekly hydrometric reports. No single reading dated July 17–20, 2026 was found; the freshest precise figure is ~598 Mm³ / ~19% around July 16, 2026. Total NAMO capacity ~2,957.6 Mm³; the dam is in the municipalities of Indé/El Oro, Durango, on the upper Nazas.
